coverage_definition: Eight project-defined geographic coverage zones spanning the base city and the Complete Edition South Central map expansion; event and content completion are excluded.

checkpoints.label: Hollywood / Sunset start
checkpoints.instruction: Enter saved free roam near Sunset/Hollywood, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: Beverly Hills / Westwood
checkpoints.instruction: Drive to the Beverly Hills or Westwood area, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: Santa Monica / Venice beachfront
checkpoints.instruction: Drive to the Santa Monica or Venice beachfront, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: Hollywood Hills / Valley
checkpoints.instruction: Drive through the Hollywood Hills into the Valley side, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: Downtown / industrial east
checkpoints.instruction: Drive to Downtown or its industrial east side, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: USC / Exposition Park
checkpoints.instruction: Drive to USC or Exposition Park in South Central, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: Crenshaw
checkpoints.instruction: Drive to the Crenshaw area, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: South Central / 105 boundary
checkpoints.instruction: Drive to the southern South Central area near the 105 boundary, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.

checkpoints.label: Hollywood / Sunset return
checkpoints.instruction: Return to the Hollywood or Sunset area, stop safely, open the full GPS map, then confirm.
